name: dank-pomodoro-timer-plus-plus
description: Pomodoro widget for DMS, with TypeScript timer and statistics

scripts.test: npm run build && TZ=Europe/Rome node --test --test-isolation=none tests/*.test.ts
scripts.lint:qml: /usr/lib/qt6/bin/qmlformat DankPomodoroWidget.qml DankPomodoroSettings.qml MinuteChart.qml PomodoroIconButton.qml PomodoroPresetsSetting.qml PomodoroDashboard.qml DashboardStatCard.qml FocusChart.qml > /dev/null
